 ☐ Version

│ Today yulastleaf published 1.45.0-beta.1
│ (bottom status bar, quota ring, Git commits,
│ etc.) from the feat/ui-2 branch, and that code
│ is not on main. If this release is numbered
│ 1.45.0, Beta users count it as newer and update
│ to it, losing those Beta features. Also, this
│ release will include the 4 unpushed commits on
│ main from the other session (notification
│ digest, safety net, third-party plan usage,
│ local web pages). Which version number should
│ this release use?

❯ 1. 1.44.1 (Recommended)
     Lower than 1.45.0-beta.1, so Beta users stay
     on Beta and nothing is lost; stable users
     get these fixes and features. Downside: the
     number is a patch bump although it contains
     features.
  2. 1.45.0
     Version semantics are correct, but Beta
     users get pulled back onto stable 1.45.0 and
     lose the status bar and other Beta features
     until the Beta content lands on main.
  3. Hold off
     Sort out the Beta branch and main with
     yulastleaf first, then release.
  4. Type something.
